summary.text: 华尔街见闻: the Dow rose 1.08% to 52177.69, the S&P 500 rose 0.33% to 7744.06, and the Nasdaq rose 0.08% to 26713.03.

华尔街见闻: September PPI rose 6.3% from a year earlier, above the 5.4% survey, and 1.3% on the month, above the 0.6% survey. Core PPI rose 5.0% from a year earlier. Retail sales rose 0.8%, above the 0.3% survey, and 0.2% once autos and gasoline are removed.
华尔街见闻: November WTI rose 3.03% to 97.97 dollars a barrel and December Brent fell 0.13% to 105.92 dollars.
华尔街见闻: the 10-year yield fell 9.6bp to 5.0892% and the 2-year yield fell to 4.753%. Spot gold rose 1.56% to 4169.33 dollars.
华尔街见闻: the Shanghai Composite fell 1.59% to 3707.48, the ChiNext index fell 2.92% to 2783.17, the Hang Seng fell 1.03% to 24062.72, and the Hang Seng Tech index fell 2.72% to 4060.99.

signal: A 6.3% producer-price print did not lift Treasury yields. The 10-year yield fell to 5.0892% as CoreWeave's five-year CDS hit 1194.5 basis points. Philadelphia chips fell 0.88% for a seventh day. WTI at 97.97 rose while Brent at 105.92 slipped after the reserve-release news.
watch: Warsh speaks with the IMF chief at 11:30 Beijing. Bailey is at 10:00, Nagel at 10:30, and Macklem at 12:15. Eurozone CPI final is at 17:00 and US import prices at 20:30. Primary dealers receive the Treasury questionnaire today. The Fed media blackout starts Saturday. The FOMC decision is 02:00 Beijing on 29 October, after this window.

themeCards.title: Producer prices just posted the biggest rise in four years
themeCards.fact: 华尔街见闻：美国9月PPI同比涨6.3%，高于预期的5.4%，环比涨1.3%，高于预期的0.6%。核心PPI同比涨5.0%，环比涨0.7%。COMEX铜期货跌1.42%至6.5660美元/磅。
themeCards.mechanism: The yearly producer-price rate at 6.3% and the monthly rate at 1.3% both cleared the survey, and copper still fell 1.42% to 6.5660. CICC (17 September): one further hike can be enough, because higher rates also slow ordinary demand and AI spending. Copper carries that 1.42% drop and the 6.5660 print, and Treasuries did not follow the drop. The theme changes if a later inflation print is at or below the 5.4% survey and copper retraces the 1.42% drop.
themeCards.trigger: PPI at or above 6.3% year on year with copper at or below 6.5660.
themeCards.invalidator: A later inflation print at or below the 5.4% survey and copper back above 6.5660.

themeCards.title: WTI rose again while Brent slipped on the reserve release
themeCards.fact: 华尔街见闻：WTI 11月合约涨3.03%至97.97美元/桶，布伦特12月合约跌0.13%至105.92美元/桶。IEA同意尽快释放剩余1亿桶石油储备，并尽快释放2000万桶柴油。一艘新加坡籍货轮在霍尔木兹海峡遭袭后沉没。
themeCards.mechanism: Brent slipped 0.13% to 105.92 on the reserve release while WTI rose 3.03% to 97.97, so the American barrel is still paying for the stock draw and the Strait attack. IEA (16 October): diesel supply stays short of demand into 2027 even after the remaining barrels are released. Oil carries the 97.97 WTI settle and the 105.92 Brent settle. The theme changes if WTI gives back the 3.03% rise and attacks on ships in the Strait stop.
themeCards.trigger: WTI holding 97.97 while a ship has been hit in the Strait and the remaining reserve release is still ahead.
themeCards.invalidator: WTI giving back the 3.03% rise and attacks on ships in the Strait stopping.

themeCards.title: Chip stocks fell for a seventh day after a strong foundry guide
themeCards.fact: 华尔街见闻：费城半导体指数跌0.88%，连跌七日。韩国综合指数跌7.57%至5554.22点，连跌七日。台积电四季度营收指引523亿至543亿美元，超出市场预期6%。
themeCards.mechanism: A sales guide above the survey still left the Philadelphia semiconductor index down 0.88% for a seventh straight session. Korea fell with it, and the Kospi closed at 5554.22 after a 7.57% drop. 财经早茶 (16 October): the quarter's sales outlook is far above the market, and management still calls the build-out cautious. The Nasdaq and Korean shares carry the 0.88% drop and the 5554.22 close. The theme changes if that semiconductor index rises for two sessions in a row.
themeCards.trigger: The Philadelphia semiconductor index extending a seventh down day with a 0.88% drop.
themeCards.invalidator: Two consecutive up sessions in the Philadelphia semiconductor index.

themeCards.title: An AI cloud CDS hit a record and long yields fell with it
themeCards.fact: 华尔街见闻：CoreWeave五年期信用违约互换利差一度升74.5个基点至1194.5个基点，五年累计违约概率超过60%，股价收涨5.94%。10年期收益率跌9.6个基点至5.0892%，现货黄金涨1.56%至4169.33美元。
themeCards.mechanism: A CDS spread at 1194.5 basis points still prices a default chance above 60% after the shares closed up 5.94%. That scare pulled the 10-year yield to 5.0892% and lifted spot gold to 4169.33. 财经早茶 (16 October): haven bids in long Treasuries largely carried through even as equities bounced a little. US credit, Treasuries, and gold carry the 1194.5 spread and the 5.0892% yield. The theme changes if that spread falls back and the 10-year yield rises back above 5.0892%.
themeCards.trigger: The five-year CDS at 1194.5 basis points with the 10-year yield at 5.0892%.
themeCards.invalidator: That CDS spread falling back and the 10-year yield rising back above 5.0892%.

themeCards.title: The Europe surplus is wide as Brussels looks at new quotas
themeCards.fact: 财新：9月对欧盟出口额同比增长25%，汽车出口额同比增长62%。财经早茶：欧盟正在评估对化学品和机械实施更多进口配额。
themeCards.mechanism: Europe-bound autos and a still-wide goods gap are the surplus the customs chart is drawing, and Brussels is now looking at quotas on chemicals and machinery. CICC (14 October): hybrid shipments into the EU are still running well ahead of last year, which lines up with that surplus. China goods exporters carry the 25% rise in sales to the EU and the 62% rise in auto exports. The theme changes if the next Europe-bound export pace falls back and the quota review is dropped.
themeCards.trigger: EU export growth at 25% and auto export growth at 62% while a quota review is underway.
themeCards.invalidator: The next Europe-bound export pace falling back and the quota review being dropped.

themeCards.title: Spot bitcoin ETFs turned to an outflow and missed the haven bid
themeCards.fact: 律动：10月15日，美国比特币现货ETF净流出2.61亿美元，FBTC净流出1.527亿美元。华尔街见闻：比特币一度跌破8万美元，未能从避险买盘中获益。
themeCards.mechanism: One session of ETF redemptions, 2.61亿美元, has not yet become the multi-day outflow that would end the theme. Bitcoin still failed to catch the haven bid that lifted gold. 律动 (15 October): the outflow was led by FBTC, so the redemption reached the second large fund. Bitcoin carries that 2.61亿美元 outflow. The theme changes if the outflow runs for several sessions, or if the price rejoins the haven bid.
themeCards.trigger: A one-day ETF outflow of 2.61亿美元 while the price misses the haven bid.
themeCards.invalidator: A multi-day ETF outflow, or the price rejoining the haven bid that lifted gold.

globalRegime: September producer prices rose at the fastest yearly pace in four years, but Thursday's session priced the AI-credit scare. Long Treasuries and gold rose, the Dow outpaced the Nasdaq, and chips fell for a seventh day. WTI rose while Brent slipped after the reserve-release news. The chart shows China's goods sales to the EU back near the top of the scale.

globalChanged.text: 财经早茶：美国9月PPI创逾四年来最大升幅，核心PPI超过调查里全部经济学家的预估，加油站销售大增也推动零售销售超预期。
财经早茶：美联储主席沃什周五将在曼谷与IMF总裁炉边谈话，市场希望从中得到利率路径的线索。
财经早茶：克利夫兰联储行长担心接连的供应冲击形成通胀心理，旧金山联储行长也对通胀的顽固更加担心。
财经早茶：国际能源署同意尽快释放3月计划里剩余的石油储备，美国官员在游说其他成员国再释放一批。
财经早茶：CoreWeave的信用违约掉期升至盘中纪录，五年内违约概率达到六成，黄仁勋称英伟达无需为其兜底。
财经早茶：Gartner预计到2030年，大量AI基础设施投资可能面临减值。
财经早茶：交易员担心财长贝森特再次压低长债收益率，本周五主要国债一级交易商将收到财政部问卷。
财经早茶：欧洲央行批准裕信银行增持德国商业银行，为取得控制权铺路。
财经早茶：MSCI就将印尼从新兴市场调整为独立市场征求意见，最迟明年6月30日决定，并冻结部分土耳其指数调整。
华尔街见闻：9月零售销售剔除汽车与汽油后仅增0.2%，用于估算GDP商品消费的控制组仅增0.1%。
华尔街见闻：纽约联储10月制造业指数升17.9点至25.5。
华尔街见闻：Anthropic三季度营收168亿美元，月度增速降至3.4%至6.6%，投资者讨论的IPO估值约1.5万亿美元。

globalImplies.text: If the next inflation print stays above the survey, copper can keep trading a hike even while long yields fall on the AI-credit scare.
If the CoreWeave CDS spread stays at the intraday high, that credit scare can keep pulling long Treasuries and gold.
If WTI holds the gain while Brent stays soft, the Strait attack and the US stock draw are still the American barrel.

globalTensions: Producer prices posted a four-year high and copper fell, but the 10-year yield fell and the Dow rose. WTI rose while Brent fell. Bitcoin missed the haven bid that lifted gold. Korea's 7.57% drop ran far ahead of the 0.88% Philadelphia semiconductor drop.
chinaStance: Pan Gongsheng restated a moderately loose stance and said global imbalances cannot be fixed by the exchange rate. He also flagged bond-market swings and AI-valuation declines as a source of financial fragility. The finance minister said fiscal policy will stay more proactive. The customs chart shows the goods surplus with the EU still widening.

chinaChanged.text: 第一财经：潘功胜在G20会议上说，全球失衡不能依靠汇率调节，人工智能相关资产估值回调加剧了金融脆弱性，人民银行将继续实施适度宽松的货币政策。
财经早茶：财政部长蓝佛安表示，将精准有效实施更加积极的财政政策。
财经早茶：欧盟正在评估对更多中国商品实施进口配额，范围包括化学品和机械，并酝酿必要时切断市场准入的工具。
财经早茶：美银证券10月初的亚洲基金经理调查把中国列为最不受青睐的市场之一，净低配比例较上月上升。
财经早茶：摩根大通维持沪深300指数的年底目标，看好企业盈利增长。
华尔街见闻：台积电三季度净利润同比增68.7%，四季度营收指引523亿至543亿美元，超出市场预期6%，全年增速上调至约44%。
财经早茶：美国众议院议员以安全为由，要求取消中远海运参与海岸警卫队船舶计划的资格。
华尔街见闻：工信部、中央网信办和市场监管总局成立联合调查组，核查尊界V800刹车踏板支架断裂问题。
华尔街见闻：中国买家购入8至10船美国大豆，每船约6.5万吨，12月起装运。
财新：9月对欧盟出口同比增长25%，汽车出口同比增长62%。

chinaImplies.text: If Brussels keeps the quota review on chemicals and machinery, the Europe surplus on the customs chart becomes a policy target.
If the PBOC keeps the moderately loose wording while warning on AI valuations, the stance is easing with a stability constraint.
If Europe-bound auto exports stay ahead of last year, the quota review has a surplus to aim at.

chinaDivergences: A-shares fell on the 见闻 tape while 财经早茶 said the Golden Dragon index rose. The customs chart shows a wide Europe surplus in the same week Brussels is assessing new quotas. Pan restated moderately loose policy and also said the exchange rate is the wrong tool for global imbalances.
